subject: Game Theory
title: Cournot Competition
description: A quick, practical guide to Cournot Competition.

hook.text: What if firms compete on quantity instead of price? Each decides how much to produce, and the market sets the price.

buildup.text: In Cournot competition, producing more lowers the price for everyone. Your gain is partly your rival's loss.

discovery.text: The Nash equilibrium: each firm produces less than the monopoly amount but more than the competitive level.

twist.text: More firms in the market push the outcome closer to perfect competition. Fewer firms mean higher prices.

climax.text: OPEC members play Cournot: each decides oil output, and the global price adjusts accordingly.

punchline.text: How much you make decides what it costs.

quiz.question: What do firms choose in Cournot competition?
